sophia_ia.description: sophIA is an autonomous software generation system that orchestrates specialized AI agents to generate code layer by layer. Powered by Claude Code with Tool Use, sophIA transforms requirements into functional software with minimal human intervention.

f4.title: Intelligent Autonomy
